name: First-Time Buyer
effect: Sale bonus +1 cash. Gain 1 Reputation when recruited.
notes: Wants an economy car for +2 combo cash.
artwork: Nervous young buyer holding keys for the first time.

name: College Graduate
effect: Sale bonus +1 cash. Gain 1 Reputation when recruited.
notes: Wants an economy or electric car for +2 combo cash.
artwork: Graduate in cap and gown beside a new car.

name: Family of Five
effect: Sale bonus +2 cash. Gain 1 Reputation when recruited.
notes: Wants an SUV for +2 combo cash.
artwork: Parents with kids, bags, stroller, and chaos.

name: Empty Nester
effect: Sale bonus +2 cash. Gain 1 Reputation when recruited.
notes: Wants something fun: MINI or sport for +2 combo cash.
artwork: Couple throwing luggage into a sporty car.

name: Lease Return Customer
effect: Sale bonus +2 cash. Gain 2 Reputation when recruited.
notes: Wants a luxury car for +2 combo cash.
artwork: Customer handing over old keys and eyeing a new car.

name: Loyal Customer
effect: Sale bonus +2 cash. Gain 2 Reputation when recruited. Stays in your showroom after you sell to them.
notes: The only customer who keeps coming back.
artwork: Beaming repeat customer waving from the showroom door.

name: BMW Enthusiast
effect: Sale bonus +3 cash. Gain 1 Reputation when recruited.
notes: Wants a sport car for +2 combo cash.
artwork: Fan wearing BMW gear, quoting chassis codes.

name: Business Owner
effect: Sale bonus +3 cash. Gain 2 Reputation when recruited.
notes: Wants an electric or luxury car for +2 combo cash.
artwork: Confident business owner with briefcase and sunglasses.

name: Referral Customer
effect: Sale bonus +2 cash. Gain 3 Reputation when recruited.
notes: Word of mouth is the best advertising.
artwork: Happy customer pointing a friend toward the showroom.

name: VIP Client
effect: Sale bonus +4 cash. Gain 2 Reputation when recruited. Requires 4 Reputation to recruit.
notes: Wants a luxury car for +2 combo cash.
artwork: Stylish VIP in sunglasses stepping out of a chauffeured car.

name: Corporate Fleet Buyer
effect: Sale bonus +5 cash. Requires 6 Reputation to recruit.
notes: Wants economy cars for +2 combo cash. Buys in volume.
artwork: Executive with a clipboard ordering multiple cars.

name: Dream Customer
effect: Sale bonus +6 cash. Gain 2 Reputation when recruited. Requires 8 Reputation to recruit.
notes: Says yes to everything. Every dealership wants them.
artwork: Glowing angelic customer saying yes immediately.

name: High Mileage Trade
effect: Sells for 2 cash plus bonuses.
artwork: Beat-up trade-in with heroic confidence.

name: Service Loaner
effect: Sells for 2 cash plus bonuses.
notes: Low miles, faint smell of coffee.
artwork: Loaner car with coffee cups and mileage stickers.

name: Base Model Sedan
effect: Sells for 3 cash plus bonuses.
artwork: Clean, modest sedan under showroom lights.

name: MINI Cooper
effect: Sells for 3 cash plus bonuses.
artwork: Bright MINI darting through city streets.

name: BMW X1
effect: Sells for 4 cash plus bonuses.
artwork: Compact BMW SUV outside a coffee shop.

name: BMW 330i
effect: Sells for 4 cash plus bonuses.
artwork: Sport sedan on a winding road.

name: BMW X3
effect: Sells for 5 cash plus bonuses.
artwork: X3 packed for a family weekend.

name: BMW X5
effect: Sells for 6 cash plus bonuses.
artwork: X5 parked outside an upscale restaurant.

name: BMW iX
effect: Sells for 6 cash plus bonuses.
artwork: Futuristic EV glowing under neon lights.

name: BMW M2
effect: Sells for 7 cash plus bonuses.
artwork: Small aggressive coupe on a track.

name: BMW M3
effect: Sells for 8 cash plus bonuses.
notes: One of the strongest vehicles on the lot.
artwork: M3 launching dramatically from a stoplight.

name: Unicorn Allocation
effect: Sells for 10 cash plus bonuses.
artwork: Mythical glowing car wrapped in allocation paperwork.

name: New Hire
effect: Each sale you close earns +1 cash.
artwork: Excited new salesperson holding a giant training binder.

name: Closer Extraordinaire
effect: When you recruit a Customer, gain 1 cash.
notes: Relationships close deals. Trust closes everything.
artwork: Slick salesperson pointing with car keys and a huge grin.

name: Product Genius
effect: When you stock a Vehicle, gain 1 Reputation.
notes: Explains every feature with dramatic confidence.
artwork: Genius explaining tech with dramatic confidence.

name: BDC Agent
effect: Draw 1 extra card at the start of your turn.
artwork: Agent wearing headset surrounded by lead alerts.

name: Service Advisor
effect: Gain 1 cash at the start of your turn.
artwork: Advisor holding repair order as phones ring.

name: F&I Manager
effect: Each sale you close earns +2 cash.
notes: Finds gross where nobody else can.
artwork: Finance manager at desk with menus and contracts.

name: Sales Manager
effect: You may play 1 additional card each of your turns.
artwork: Desk manager pointing at a four-square worksheet.

name: Legendary Salesman
effect: Each sale you close earns +3 cash.
notes: They named a showroom after him.
artwork: Silver-haired legend in front of a wall of sales plaques.

name: Cold Call
effect: Gain 2 cash and draw 1 card. If every rival has more Customers than you, gain 1 Reputation.
artwork: Grinning salesperson working the phone in a busy showroom.

name: Marketing Campaign
effect: Gain 2 Reputation and draw 1 card.
artwork: Salesperson with a megaphone in front of banners and balloons.

name: Flash Sale
effect: Gain 3 cash and draw 1 card.
artwork: Giant FLASH SALE starburst over a row of cars.

name: Trade Show
effect: Draw 3 cards, then discard 1 card.
artwork: Crowded auto expo floor with spotlights.

name: Sales Training
effect: You may play 1 additional card this turn. Draw 1 card.
notes: Closing rate up and to the right.
artwork: Trainer at a whiteboard labeled CLOSING RATE.

name: Grand Opening
effect: Gain 3 cash and draw 2 cards.
artwork: Ribbon-cutting ceremony with red balloons.

name: Showroom Expansion
effect: You may have 1 additional Customer in your showroom. Draw 1 card.
artwork: Construction crew expanding a gleaming showroom.

name: New Location
effect: You may have 1 additional Customer in your showroom. Draw 1 card.
artwork: Map with a NEW! pin dropped on it.

name: Website Upgrade
effect: Increase your hand size limit by 1. Draw 1 card.
artwork: Monitor showing a shiny new dealership website.

name: Premium Inventory
effect: Your cars are worth 1 more cash when sold, for the rest of the game. Draw 1 card.
notes: Only the good stuff on this lot.
artwork: Row of exotic cars gleaming on the front line.

name: Luxury Upgrade
effect: Your cars are worth 2 more cash when sold, for the rest of the game.
notes: Velvet ropes on the showroom floor.
artwork: Sedan behind velvet ropes under a spotlight.

name: Market Research
effect: Look at the top 4 cards of the deck. Put the best one in your hand and discard the rest.
notes: Know the market, beat the market.
artwork: Analyst with pie charts and market reports.

name: Corporate Contact
effect: Look at the top 3 cards of the deck. Put the best one in your hand and discard the rest.
notes: A friend at the factory never hurts.
artwork: Executive on the phone with corporate headquarters.

name: Referral Bonus
effect: Gain 2 cash for each rival that has more Customers than you. Draw 1 card.
artwork: Salesperson giving a thumbs up under a REFERRAL BONUS banner.

name: Last Minute Deal
effect: Gain 2 cash. You may play 1 additional card this turn.
artwork: Alarm clock ringing over a frantic deal desk.

name: Inventory Blowout
effect: Gain 4 cash, then discard 2 cards.
artwork: BLOWOUT SALE banner over a packed car lot.

name: Competitor Spy
effect: Look at a rival's hand. They discard their best card.
artwork: Trench-coated spy with binoculars watching a rival lot.

name: False Rumors
effect: A rival loses 2 Reputation and their least valuable Customer leaves.
notes: In this town, talk is cheap and damage is expensive.
artwork: Two gossips whispering as a storm brews over a rival dealership.

name: Bad Survey
effect: A rival loses 3 Reputation.
artwork: Angry survey form glowing red.

name: Chargeback
effect: A rival loses 3 cash.
notes: Money flying backward out of the drawer.
artwork: Money flying backward out of a cash drawer.

name: Internet Lead Ghosts You
effect: A rival's best Customer leaves their showroom.
artwork: Empty chat bubble and abandoned coffee.

name: Market Domination
effect: Steal the best Customer from each rival, while you have showroom space.
notes: The best offense is a bigger billboard.
artwork: Triumphant dealer looming over the city skyline.
